'''Hathor 40 Hz''' is the gamma-entrainment surface published at hathor.live/40hz. It runs an in-browser entrainment session, presents a library of presets, and documents both the evidence and the hardware — including how to build the stimulation devices yourself.

== What it offers ==
* '''Session''' — an entrainment session generated live in the browser.
* '''The library''' — a set of presets to run.
* '''What the evidence says''' — a plain summary of the [[Gamma Entrainment]] research line and its limits, including a placebo baseline.
* '''Practices that need no hardware''' — the half of the method that requires no device.
* '''The build''' — instructions for building the stimulation hardware at low cost, including a '''TENS''' unit and a '''tDCS''' unit, with the safety engineering taught as part of the build.

== Relationship to other surfaces ==
Hathor 40 Hz is the hardware-and-evidence companion to [[MELEK Sleep and Focus]] (sleep.melek.salon), which generates binaural beats, isochronic tones and a 40 Hz preset as pure audio in the browser. The research context for both is in [[Gamma Entrainment]] and [[Display Refresh and Flicker Delivery]].

== Honesty note ==
The surface states what the evidence does and does not support and carries a placebo baseline rather than promising a clinical outcome.
